SELECT A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,A.DHRN_BILL As RefNoL,B.AC_NAME As PartyNameL,A.AC_NAME As VchNameL,A.MAIN_USER As UserL FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.VCH_NO

Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? LOAN REC ? AND A.AC_GR IN('01','03','04') ? AND A.AC_GR = '15' ? ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? LOAN REC ? AND A.AC_GR IN('01','03','04') ? AND A.AC_GR = '15' ? AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
Select * From EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND EMP_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME As EmpNameL,EMP_CODE As EmpL FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_NAME
SELECT VCH_DESC As VchDescL FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA WHERE VCH_DESC <> '' AND LEN(VCH_DESC) < ? AND VCH_DESC <> '' GROUP BY VCH_DESC ORDER BY VCH_DESC

SELECT B.ISU_NO AS IsuNoL,A.DHRN_BILL AS RefNoL,FORMAT(A.VCH_DATE,'dd/MM/yyyy') AS IsuDateM,C.AC_NAME,A.DHRN_AMT AS DhiranAmtR,A.INT_PRC AS InterestR,B.ISU_YRCD AS YearM, B.ISU_DBCD As BookM,sum(B.DHRN_REC_AMT)As DhrnRecR,A.GOLD_DESC As ItemDesc FROM (DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN DHRN_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE =' ? ' GROUP BY A.VCH_DATE,B.ISU_NO,A.DHRN_AMT,A.INT_PRC,C.AC_NAME,B.ISU_DBCD,B.ISU_YRCD,A.DHRN_BILL,A.GOLD_DESC HAVING SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) < A.DHRN_AMT ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.ISU_NO
